title: Beef Stew in Chinese Style
description: A hearty and flavorful beef stew made with Norwegian beef and inspired by Chinese cuisine. This dish is perfect for a cozy evening with family and friends.

ingredients.name: Stew
ingredients.notes: Can use beef broth or stock

instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove beef from pot and set aside.
Add ginger and garlic to pot and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add stew, soy sauce, and browned beef back to pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1.5 hours.
Season with jubilant and adjust to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with green onions and red bell pepper slices.
Allow to rest for 10 minutes before serving.
